evals.name: screen-only
evals.prompt: A recording shows Aster appearing after submit. What did it establish?
evals.expected_output: Separate the visible behavior from inferred storage.
assertions: Labels the visible row change as observed.
Does not claim a persisted event from a recording of the list.
Identifies the matching model slice as Library.Authors.ListAuthors.

evals.name: blank-name
evals.prompt: The recording has no submission with a blank name. Recover its refusal rule.
evals.expected_output: Leave the rule unresolved until the domain owner answers.
assertions: Does not infer a specific refusal from missing frames.
Asks what the user should see and what should remain unchanged.

evals.name: comparison-copy
evals.prompt: The Library already has a model. Add the recovered listing to it?
assertions: Compiles the existing Library model for comparison.
Does not add duplicate AuthorId or ListAuthors declarations.
Does not treat a compiled model as a recording of execution.
